evaluation_status: exploratory reuse of previously examined CARE turbines; no fresh external validation
research7_policy: same feature order as reviewed research artifact, all seven required; measurements delayed 10 minutes; no circular encoding or counter transformation in this control
history160_policy: unchanged H24 causal physical features, windows 1/6/24 hours, no event labels or IDs; preserve NaN for XGBoost
preprocessing: MinMaxScaler fitted on eligible training rows only, feature_range [0,1], clip=false, no additional scaler and no imputation
class_balance: scale_pos_weight = negative_count/positive_count on training rows only; no sampling across folds
split_rule: same five fixed whole-turbine outer folds as H24; next asset cyclically is inner validation, remaining three train
threshold_policy: reuse frozen NBM operational selector; validation only; maximize onset event recall, minimize normal warning fraction, minimize false-alarm rate, maximize precision then threshold; disable if no eligible onset
candidate_selection: validation only; maximize onset recall, minimize normal warning fraction, minimize false-alarm rate, maximize precision; exact tie favors research7
event_success: new observed below-to-above crossing within [failure-24h,failure); left-censored high states do not count; report window coverage separately
episode_denominator: all 11 canonical faults, including unavailable forecasts
score_semantics: uncalibrated class-1 score for annotated failure within 24 hours; no calibrated probability, RUL or future sensor trajectory
